description: This PHP script defines a subpanel view for displaying users related to roles in SuiteCRM, including UI elements, list view initialization, and template assignments.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in SuiteCRM, initialized with a template and used to assign variables and process the list display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template for the list view with specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the query parameters for fetching list data.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text or HTML content for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data and display parameters.
